title: 1999 additions and alterations: CCC refused in a high wind and sea-spray zone (Tauranga)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: Code in force at the 1999 consent (p.14 §7.1)
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Original single-storey house built under a 1970 permit; the 1999 additions and alterations are the disputed scope; substantial completion June 2000.
Site is near-level and exposed in a sea-spray zone and a high to very high wind zone; the completed house is assessed as high weathertightness risk.
Disputed items after agreed remedies: barge/wall intersections, and parapets and roof cladding; applicant requested a modification of the B2.3.1 durability start date.
Decision: authority correct to refuse the CCC because building elements did not comply with the Code in force when the consent was issued.
